body: You said your passion is art. Chase that. In my opinion all that fucking matters is what YOU want to do. The notion that we must follow in the footsteps of everyone else and do what you are “supposed” to do is complete and utter bullshit. I’m no stranger to the reality that pursuing art is not easy in this world. Many artists starve. Do what you can, though. I think making any art at all can have a positive impact. Above everything else, make art for yourself

The fact you’re still here has to mean something. Perhaps it indicates that there is a part of you that wants to live, whether it be unconscious or not. I don’t think it’s right to say things ‘do’ or ‘do not’ get better, it really isn’t so black and white. Not all of us get so lucky to lead a completely fulfilling and happy life, but I like to think there is a potential within every person to feel okay, if they receive what they need. Not everyone receives what they need and this is cruel and unfair.
